highlights: Develop Go backend services and APIs supporting dataset ingestion, egress, and data-quality workflows.
Build multitenant application capabilities through coordinated changes to Go backend services and React frontend components.
Develop Kafka stream-processing workflows for datasets and improve data quality across ingestion and egress jobs.
Build automated tests for backend services, APIs, and data-processing workflows while maintaining 90%+ SonarQube coverage.

Deployed backend workloads using AWS EC2, S3, and RDS to support cloud-based application processing and data storage.
Applied AWS IAM roles and policies to strengthen access control and support secure resource management.
Enhanced CI/CD pipelines with GitHub Actions to automate builds and support consistent deployments.
Used Amazon CloudWatch and SNS for application monitoring, alerting, troubleshooting, and production reliability.

Collaborated with backend engineers to design scalable, secure Java solutions using the Spring Framework.
Optimized SQL and MongoDB operations using JavaScript and SQL, reducing website load times by 40% and improving data retrieval.

Improved Jenkins and GitHub Actions CI/CD pipelines to streamline deployments and reduce manual intervention.
